Provisional choice; three requested editors await access. The October30 study demonstrates19.2chemical3Dvolumes/second (about52ms) in cultured cells. Approximately400times compares earlier similar MIP tomography,around0.05volumes/second. Live COS-7 lipid-droplet tracking and fixed-cell spectroscopy are distinct demonstrations. Condensate studies are prospective; the final paragraph’s suggestion of an achieved clearer condensate view exceeds the demonstrated result. Heat-related optical signals supply chemical contrast. Depth limits,illumination effects and clinical/commercial outcomes retain separate questions. Rate describes volume acquisition;live processing speed requires separate verification. The dance analogy/artwork are illustrative.

暂行选稿；其他三位受邀编辑仍待恢复访问。10月30日研究展示每秒19.2幅三维化学图像，约52毫秒一幅。“约400倍”针对较早同类MIP断层成像，参照约每秒0.05幅。活COS-7细胞脂滴追踪与固定细胞光谱分析是不同实验。凝聚体研究属于未来应用，当前实测主要涉及脂滴；光热相关光学信号提供化学对比。成像深度、照明影响及临床和商业结果仍各有验证问题。中文作者汉字姓名未核实，以括号内罗马字署名为准；“化学反应”宜理解为化学分布与脂滴运动。专利披露包括已授权与申请中项目。舞蹈比喻与插画属于解释。

October29 university report/October EMNLP proceedings describe an internal controller requiring hidden-state access. Authors: Pramanik/Sumit Jha at Florida,Maliha at Oklahoma,Susmit Jha at SRI. Proceedings publication is verified;an actual talk is outside this review. Pilot14,832turns and93.5% role consistency are different evaluations. AppendixA8 also says200conversations each over100turns;the relationship to14,832annotated turns needs clarification. Table12(T2):ATLAS96.8Ktokens/17.5s,A-MEM118.5K/22.1s,single-agent28.4K/4.2s;spectral work under2% there. Training-free preserves weights;inference costs remain. Benchmark gains leave production safety/factual reliability open. Future independent replication is a possibility;an announced replication plan remains unverified. Opening job examples,scouts/navigation are illustration.

10月29日大学报道与10月EMNLP论文集介绍需要隐藏状态访问的内部控制器。署名机构：Pramanik与Sumit Jha属佛罗里达大学，Maliha属俄克拉荷马大学，Susmit Jha属SRI；已核实论文集发表，实际现场报告仍待核实。14832轮先导研究与93.5%角色一致性属于不同评估。附录A8另称200组对话每组超过100轮，与14832轮已标注对话的统计关系需澄清。表12的T2测试中：ATLAS96.8千tokens／17.5秒，A-MEM118.5千／22.1秒，单代理28.4千／4.2秒；谱运算占运行时间低于2%。免训练保留权重，推理仍有成本。生产安全、事实可靠性与独立复现仍有验证问题；未来复现计划待核实。罗盘等图像属于比喻。
